title: Certificates of Deposit: The Account That Takes Over Paid-Out Interest
content:
When interest from a certificate within PCB's Certificates of Deposit is being paid to an account that has been closed, a replacement receiving account has to be chosen. This page states which account it is.

## Rule

- **An account of the same kind.** The interest carries on being paid out, now to the owner's active account of the kind the interest goes to, which is recorded as the new payout account: the owner's active checking account where interest goes to checking, the owner's active savings account where it goes to savings.
- **Which active account.** The bank's records at the moment of the change decide which of the owner's accounts of that kind is active.
- **No active account of that kind.** If the owner has no active account of the kind the interest is paid to, the interest setting switches to compounding, and the owner's active account of the other kind is recorded as payout account.

## Input, judgement, outcome (hypothetical owner records)

| Interest paid to | Owner's active checking | Owner's active savings | New interest setting | New payout account |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Savings (closed) | Premier Checking | Goal Builder Savings | still paid to savings | Goal Builder Savings |
| Checking (closed) | Everyday Checking | Statement Savings | still paid to checking | Everyday Checking |
| Savings (closed) | Interest Checking | none | compounding | Interest Checking |
| Checking (closed) | none | Money Market Account | compounding | Money Market Account |
